guide_target.label: アークザラッドⅡ（プレイステーション クラシック内蔵・日本国内版）

notes: No title-scoped source exception is used.
Set A is the directly inspectable Japanese ちょこた/みどりすたいる walkthrough family.
Set B is the independent Japanese アークザラッド２ データまとめ Wiki* family, using timing, region, boss, bounty, character, item, and guild-job pages as a composite verification set.

Sony's Japanese PlayStation Blog is authoritative for the 2018 domestic PlayStation Classic target. A directly inspected Japanese PlayStation Classic hands-on report confirms Arc I and Arc II share virtual memory-card data and conversion works.

The PlayStation Classic title has no standalone retail package; cover_url uses Sony's Arc II image from the exact PlayStation Classic announcement page rather than substituting a different retail edition cover.

mandatory: complete main story through Air Castle and final boss
complete all guild jobs, respecting expiration and prerequisite chains
hunt all practical source-documented wanted monsters and flag one-time steal/drop conflicts
recruit optional permanent characters/summons available within Arc II
cover Ruins Dungeon/Choko content and all source-verified timing-critical optional content
collect source-verified one-time/unique rewards whose opportunity can permanently disappear
optional_conversion: conversion-only secret research-lab scene early in the story
early Choko availability if Arc I Choko data was converted
full Choko awakening continuation below Ruins Dungeon B50 after the late Tokoko event
excluded: Monster Game/casino external-disc transfers and prizes
arbitrary random drops and exhaustive generic treasure collection

critical_findings: Early guild jobs G#01, G#02, G#03 expire at the ceremony; G#07 depends on G#01 and has its own early limit.
After Yagos, G#04→G#05→G#06 and later G#08 plus G#11/#12 and G#14→#15→#16 must be completed before White House ends.
During Lieza/Gogen's Fores segment, G#29 and G#30 exist only for that temporary party window.
During Shu/Tosh's Romalia segment, G#26 has a very short window; G#24→#25 can remain until Air Castle but are safest here.
After the Chimera Research Lab reunion, G#27→#28 unlock; most midgame guild jobs later die when the Monji/Palencia-Tower arc accelerates.
G#17 should be cleared immediately after Greycine for best result; G#18 must be a great success for G#10's chain.
Fores becomes temporarily country-locked after sleeping at the inn until Ghia Temple is cleared.
After Brakia, G#52→#56 and G#55→#57→#58 form a prerequisite chain; G#58 additionally requires G#54 great success.
Amigue G#42 has an especially short window: after permission for God's Tower and before Amigue completion.
Barbarad G#49 only appears once Pyramid exterior progression starts; most remaining jobs fail when the Monji arc accelerates.
G#37 is a late God Hunter job requiring the north/south towers cleared, 250 GP, and the God Hunter proof; it expires at Air Castle entry.
G#23 starts during Romalia city-wall progression and expires when Air Castle rises.
Entering Air Castle is the final world lockout.
Choko can be recruited without conversion after reaching Ruins Dungeon B50, but the post-Tokoko B51-B71 awakening continuation requires converted Arc I data in which Choko was recruited.
In Tokoko's later battle, wiping out all green slimes permanently kills the awakening continuation; escape southwest instead and collect Red Shoes during that battle.

Wanted monster Shamus has a unique Grand Knife steal; Tianus's unique Uninyan Sword is only stealable on the first encounter; Grovis appears only during the Sea Oil Field escape and has a Fate steal that conflicts with having already hunted Balzac.
The one-time Palencia street vendor appears only on initial arrival during Elk's split segment.
Elk's dream has the rare Flame Sword drop; it is a synthesis input and retrying is inconvenient.
Palencia Tower 77F is optional but contains unique/rare treasure accessed by repeatedly toggling the 99F elevator switch.

To obtain both the unique Fate and the full bounty clear, postpone Balzac until after Grovis: Returnless Forest remains available as an FBA after White House, while Grovis appears only during the timed Sea Oil Field escape. Steal Fate from Grovis with Shu first; then return to Returnless Forest and hunt Balzac.

Conversion chronology correction: the Secret Research Lab event belongs before the ceremony/Yagos transition, while the Ark-versus-Andel conversion event occurs after White House. They must be separate sections.
The Shu/Tosh story section is split at Tosh recruitment so G#24-26, especially short-window G#26, are completed before tunnel/hideout progression can invalidate the job.
Amigue is split at the elder's tower permission: G#39-42 are authored before God's Tower, because G#42 expires when the Amigue arc ends.
Barbarad is split after the Pyramid exterior battle: G#49 only appears at that point, so the final pre-Monji guild cleanup must occur before returning to complete the Pyramid.

Choko's midgame cemetery/Tokoko sequence should be done after Millmana once Choko is Lv55+: during the green-slime battle, do not wipe the slimes, collect the one-time Red Shoes, and escape southwest. The ruined-village continuation is a separate later stage after the north/south towers.

Romalia invasion is split before city completion: G#23 appears when the city-wall assault begins and expires when Air Castle rises, so deliver the amulet while Romalia city is still accessible; entering the final plaza/finishing the city also locks out city treasure.
